description:
Iterly is the ultimate companion app designed specifically for independent developers who want to take control of their app production lifecycle. 
Say goodbye to scattered notes and generic project management tools. Iterly brings order to your development chaos by combining task tracking with structured release planning.
Whether you are squashing bugs for a hotfix or mapping out a massive 2.0 overhaul, Iterly helps you visualize exactly what needs to be done to ship your next update with confidence.

KEY FEATURES:
* Release-Centric Organization: Group your tasks, features, and fixes by specific app version numbers so you always know what is dropping next.
* Focused Task Management: Create, prioritize, and check off items tailored specifically to software development workflows (Features, Bugs, Improvements).
* Intuitive Dashboard: Get a bird's-eye view of your entire app history, past releases, and current milestones.
* Built for Indie Devs: Clean, fast, and completely focused on the unique needs of single developers and small teams trying to ship high-quality apps efficiently.

Stop managing your app updates in spreadsheets. Download Iterly today and start iterating smarter!
whatsNew:
Iterly is now at home on iPad and iPhone Duo — plan releases in a roomy split view with your projects on one side and the details on the other.

New
• Full iPad support with a sidebar and split-view Projects layout that adapts as you resize or multitask.
• Made for iPhone Duo: layouts adjust as you unfold, with the split view ready on the big inner screen.
• Attach photos and videos while creating a task, not just afterwards.
• New Discovery status for projects you're still exploring, before Planning.

Improved
• The Brainstorm button now shows a dot when it has notes, so you know there's something inside.
• Comfortable reading widths on larger screens, plus a tidier activity heatmap.
• Better VoiceOver labels and larger tap targets throughout the app.
• Smoother, more reliable navigation between projects, task lists, and tasks.

Fixed
• Tapping a widget now takes you straight to the right screen.
• Inline edits are now always saved, and you'll see a clear message if a save ever fails.
• Deleting a project no longer leaves the screen in a confusing state.
• Fixed the Remove Ads screen being cut off on smaller displays.
promotionalText: Plan your next release on the big screen. Iterly now runs beautifully on iPad and iPhone Duo, and you can attach media as you create a task.
